preferences.warning: Your preferences will apply in this tab, but could not be saved.

feedback.emptyBody: New activity will appear here when it is available.

story.title: Clarity before change.
story.body: A considered place for technical change, its impact, and the decisions that follow.

login.title: Welcome to your workspace
login.body: Sign in with the workspace identifier provided by your organization.
login.required: Enter your workspace, email address, and password.
login.credentials: Unable to sign in. Check your workspace, email, and password.
login.ended: Your session ended or could not be verified. Sign in again.
login.invitationOnly: Access is managed by your organization. Ask your administrator for an invitation.
login.localLogout: Signed out of this tab. Previously issued sessions may remain valid until they expire.
login.storageWarning: Session storage is unavailable. You can continue in this tab, but refreshing may require sign-in. Close the tab if saved-session removal is blocked.

invitation.title: Join your workspace
invitation.body: Complete your invitation to activate your membership.
invitation.name: Full name
invitation.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, up to 72 UTF-8 bytes. Password managers and paste are supported.
invitation.missing: This page has no usable invitation link. Reopen the original link or ask your workspace administrator for a new invitation. Refresh cannot recover a removed link.
invitation.unavailable: This invitation is unavailable. It may have expired, been revoked, or already been used. Sign in if you completed acceptance, or request a new invitation.
invitation.accepted: Membership activated. Sign in with your workspace and email to continue. No automatic sign-in was performed.
invitation.invalid: Enter a name of 2–255 characters and a password within the stated limits.
invitation.network: The result could not be confirmed. Try signing in if acceptance completed, or re-enter your password to retry. No automatic retry was made.

home.title: Your workspace, in focus.
home.body: Choose a work area to continue. The areas available to you follow your current membership.
home.identityOnly: Your current membership provides workspace identity access. Contact your administrator if you need another work area.
home.changes: Review change requests, their impact, and their progress.
home.foundation: Maintain the service foundation and its relationships.
home.users: Review members and manage workspace access.
home.notifications: Follow activity relevant to your membership.
home.limitsBody: Tenant risk-rule isolation and CAB enforcement are planned work. AI integration is not active.
home.systems: Browse systems and their direct relationships.

verify.title: Verify your membership again?
verify.body: The workspace will reload its identity and permissions. Unsaved workspace changes will be cleared.

legacy.title: Business workspace
legacy.body: This existing workspace is available in English while its pages are being migrated. Your data and access rules stay the same.
legacy.dataError: The requested record could not be loaded.

checking.title: Verifying your workspace
checking.body: Your data will appear after your session is verified.

unavailable.title: We couldn't verify your session
unavailable.body: Your workspace data stays hidden. Try again, or return to sign in. No password was saved.

forbidden.title: This page isn't available to your membership
forbidden.body: You can return to your workspace or contact your administrator if you need access.

notFound.title: This page couldn't be found
notFound.body: The address may have changed. Return to your workspace to continue.

unexpected.title: The page couldn't be opened
unexpected.body: Try reloading the page. Your account details and request information have not been displayed.

systems.intro: Explore systems, their direct dependencies and recorded incidents.
systems.localFilters: Filters apply to the loaded catalog only
systems.name: System
systems.assignmentHint: Department and owner references are shown here. Available names appear in system details.
systems.noMatchesBody: Adjust your search or clear the filters to see the available systems.
systems.emptyBody: Systems will appear here when they are recorded for your workspace.
systems.oneHopBody: This view shows immediate dependencies only. It does not traverse the wider network.
systems.noIncidents: No incidents recorded for this system.
systems.originalEnglish: The following narrative and relationship summaries are supplied by the backend in their original English.

loading.title: Loading systems
loading.body: Retrieving the current workspace’s authorized data.

forbidden.title: Access unavailable
forbidden.body: Your current permissions do not allow this view.
